proposed.text: An assembly hall with 600 occupants has its dispersal area located 20 meters from the nearest exit. Does this hall require an automatic sprinkler system under PD 1096?

options.text: No, because the dispersal area is less than 30 meters from the exit
Yes, because the occupant load alone exceeds 500 persons
Yes, because both conditions — over 500 occupants and exits over 30 meters from dispersal — must be evaluated independently
No, because assembly halls are exempt from sprinkler requirements under Sec. 1212

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Assembly halls trigger the sprinkler requirement only when BOTH conditions are met: occupant load exceeds 500 AND exits are more than 30m from the dispersal area. With exits only 20m away, the second condition is not satisfied even though the occupant load exceeds 500.
proposed.explanation: This is a conjunction (AND) condition, not a disjunction (OR). The occupant load threshold alone is insufficient — the physical distance from the dispersal area to the exit must also exceed 30m. When exits are close to the dispersal area, rapid occupant egress makes the sprinkler requirement unnecessary for assembly halls specifically.
